cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
echo "--- successes (T=) and first/last 403 per log, today+yesterday"
grep -n "\[BUFR\].*T=" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | tail -8 | cut -c1-170
echo "--- line numbers/time of first BUFR lines after midnight rollover"
grep -n "\[BUFR\]" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | awk -F'[: ]' '{print $2":"$3}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -k2 | head -60 | tr '\n' ' '
echo
echo "--- BUFR success/403 by hour (all log)"
grep -h "\[BUFR\]" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | awk '{h=substr($1,1,2); if($0~/403/)e[h]++; else if($0~/T=/)s[h]++; else if($0~/кулдаун/)c[h]++} END{for(i=0;i<24;i++){k=sprintf("%02d",i); printf "%s ok=%d 403=%d cool=%d\n",k,s[k],e[k],c[k]}}'
echo "--- other meteomanz users"
grep -c -i "meteomanz" /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log
grep -h -i "meteomanz\|BUFR fallback\|403" /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log | tail -5 | cut -c1-200
echo "--- ground station verify BUFR calls"
grep -rn "fetch_latest_bufr_essentials\|fetch_latest_meteomanz_essentials" scripts/*.py | grep -v "def " | cut -c1-160
echo "--- curl test headers"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "plain curl: %{http_code}\n" -A "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) Chrome/120" "https://www.meteomanz.com/"
curl -sI -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10)" "https://www.meteomanz.com/" | head -5
